name: Next prayer
description: The next prayer, its time and how long is left.
about: The next of the five prayers with its time and what is left, worked out on the TV from your place: no network and no account. Choose the place on the phone page, and the method and the Asr rule that your mosque follows. The times can differ by a minute or two from a mosque's timetable. The calculation and the idea are from @mashhour134 (pull request 121).
